runs.name: rank
runs.command: thinkthen rank 'Does this need an answer today?' --lines --top 2 < inbox.txt
runs.input:
Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here
Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay
The client needs the signed quote by 5 pm today.
Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days
runs.output:
Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay
The client needs the signed quote by 5 pm today.
runs.see: The checkout outage comes first, and the quote the client needs by 5 pm today comes second.

runs.name: rank-answer
runs.command: thinkthen rank --details 'Does this need an answer today?' --lines --top 2 < inbox.txt | jq -r '"\(.answer.probability)  \(.input)"'
runs.input:
Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here
Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay
The client needs the signed quote by 5 pm today.
Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days
runs.output:
0.94  Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay
0.93  The client needs the signed quote by 5 pm today.
runs.see: The details put the outage at 0.94 and the quote due today at 0.93. Both need an answer today.

runs.name: rank-jsonl
runs.command: thinkthen rank 'Does this stop customers from buying?' --jsonl --field /title --top 1 < bugs.jsonl
runs.see: The checkout crash stops customers from buying, so B-2 comes back first, id and all.
